item.title: Fatal Highway 6 collision claims life of Green River Mayor
item.description: A fatal accident on Highway 6 took the life of 40-year-old Ren Hatt, the mayor of Green River City. According to Utah Highway Patrol reports, a 2021 Freightliner semi was traveling westbound on Highway 6 on Dec. 5.
